name: Watermelon
details: A highly realistic 3D model of a whole Watermelon, showcasing the classic dark and light green variegated stripes with natural organic accuracy. The asset features a smooth, slightly glossy rind texture that accurately simulates the thick, moisture-rich skin of fresh summer produce. Utilizing optimized 2K texture maps, it balances photographic realism with a lightweight file footprint, ensuring the large fruit model renders flawlessly across all mobile device categories. It is an excellent asset for botanical studies, digital agricultural trade shows, interactive cooking games, and modern grocery e-commerce app integrations. Users can project the watermelon into their physical environment using AR to analyze its lifelike proportions, scale, and coloration. It functions perfectly within InfoScan for fast, efficient, and lag-free performance.
